top_choice_rationale: P001 (Buchwald and Hartwig, ligand-controlled Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling) is mature, mechanistically explained by ligand control of oxidative addition, amine binding and reductive elimination, and has the cleanest two-person credit on the slate. The overlap with the 2010 C-C coupling prize is answered by a citation limited to ligand-controlled C-N bond construction, with Kosugi, Migita, Guram and Rennels stated openly as precursors. The B014 proposals have the stronger novelty claim, but the credit is unresolved and no PROTAC is approved. I rank the Ciulli trio (P003) above the Handa trio (P002) because it describes one coherent PROTAC strand and avoids omitting Ito beside Handa.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; she is a Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, but no conflict with any proposal
